parameters.query:
SELECT
  pp.id::int AS "id",
  pp.parqueadero_usuario_id::int AS "parkingUserId",
  COALESCE(current_vehicle.id, 0)::int AS "vehicleId",
  pm.modalidad AS "modality",
  pp.monto::double precision AS "amount",
  pp.fecha_inicio::text AS "startDate",
  pp.fecha_fin::text AS "endDate",
  pp.estado AS "status",
  pp.metodo_pago AS "method",
  pp.referencia AS "reference",
  pp.motivo_rechazo AS "rejectionReason",
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.parqueadero_autorizaciones pa WHERE pa.pago_id = pp.id) AS "authorizationIssued"
FROM public.parqueadero_pagos pp
JOIN public.parqueadero_modalidades pm ON pm.id = pp.modalidad_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT pv.id
  FROM public.parqueadero_vehiculos pv
  WHERE pv.parqueadero_usuario_id = pp.parqueadero_usuario_id AND pv.activo = TRUE
  ORDER BY pv.es_principal DESC, pv.id
  LIMIT 1
) current_vehicle ON TRUE
ORDER BY pp.fecha_pago DESC, pp.id DESC;
